You fool! What have you done?! Why, why go and delve into caverns where you are not welcome?!
Chat ends.
false
I demand you fix this. This is your fault. I can feel it, clawing at me, tearing at me. Like some great beast.
Rid me of this. Rid me of this plague. Clear my mind of these memories. I know you can. Use this gift that you have and end it all. Now.
Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.
Those are a different kind of memory, Roathe. It won't work on them. They are buried deeper in your psyche.
Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.
Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.
That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt.
And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?
I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, darling.
I will simply claim you are lying, and it will likely damage my opinion of you beyond repair.
No. I can't do this. I won't do this. We have to face down this situation together. Can't we just talk about this?
I... there's really no other way?
No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.
That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.
What say you?
Okay. I'll... I'll do it. I'll wipe your mind. Even if it'll take Marie and Lyon's with it.
No. I refuse. I'll find another way to convince you to move forward.
+10 Chemistry
I wish you the best of luck.
Good. Get to it.
